description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest supported Java and framework baseline.
tasks.reason: The service currently targets Java 8 and legacy Java EE APIs, which are not aligned with the latest modernization target.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application to Java 25 and modern framework-compatible APIs, including migration from javax.* usage to jakarta.* where required by the selected framework path.

tasks.description: Modernize core service integrations to Azure cloud-native managed services.
tasks.reason: The modernization goal explicitly requires adoption of cloud-native Azure services.
tasks.requirements: Migrate SQL connectivity to Azure SQL Database with managed identity authentication and move application secrets to Azure Key Vault for centralized secret management.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency CVEs before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required for every modernization plan to reduce deployment risk.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs, upgrade vulnerable packages to patched versions, and validate build and test outcomes after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The project modernization goal includes deployment to Azure using a cloud-native hosting model.
tasks.requirements: Containerize as needed and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps using existing or newly provisioned Azure resources.
